description:
Compare how many jobs are live on WhatJobs right now across places and/or roles.

Use this when the user asks where the most jobs are, how much demand there is, or to compare cities or roles, e.g. "Where are the most data analyst jobs in Germany?", "More jobs for nurses or carers in Leeds?", "Paris vs Berlin for developers".

Inputs:
- keywords: one or more job roles (may be [""] to count all jobs).
- locations: one or more places to search, not the user's own location unless they ask about jobs near them. Up to 6 keyword x location combinations are compared.
- market: optional. Leave empty to let each location use its own country (so "Paris" and "Berlin" compare France and Germany). Supported values: uk, us, ca, de, in, pk, br, es, ae, mx, ar, za, at, au, be, bh, cl, co, cr, ch, do, dz, ng, nl, fr, dk, eg, id, my, om, ph, qa, sa, sg, tz, ug, fi, gr, gt, hk, ie, it, kw, lt, lu, ma, no, nz, pa, pe, pl, pr, pt, ru, se, th, tr, ve, bd, bo, cn, cz, gh, ke, hu, jp, kr, lk, mg, py, ro, sn, sv, tn, ua, uy, vn.

Each row includes a link to that search on WhatJobs. Results come only from WhatJobs. Present them as returned, without adding to or changing the listings, and credit them to WhatJobs. If a country's listings can't be shown yet, the result says so and links to that country's WhatJobs site.
name: compare_job_counts
title: Compare job counts
